messages.subject: Factor Scores Weights
parts:
Hello everyone!

In a CFA (second order latent model ) I would like to obtain the factor scores weights for my second order latent. I used the WLSMV estimator (ordinal variables), and after running the commands:

UWES9_2nd_ord_lat <- 'vig =~ U1 + U2 + U5
          ded =~ U3 + U4 + U7
          abs =~ U6 + U8 + U9
          eng =~ vig + ded + abs'

fit_2nd_ord_lat <- cfa(UWES9_2nd_ord_lat,data = data, estimator = "WLSMV", ordered=c("U1","U2","U3","U4","U5","U6","U7","U8","U9"))
SC <- lavaan:::lav_predict_eta(fit_2nd_ord_lat, fsm = TRUE)
attr(SC, "fsm")[[1]]

I obtain:

NULL

Professor Rosseel already told me that calculate the means of factor scores weights for each item isn't a solution. What would you do? How to obtain the factor scores weights with this estimator?

Thanks!
